archives.name: Yad Vashem — Central Database of Shoah Victims' Names
archives.covers: The central names database of Shoah victims. Pages of Testimony, deportation lists, and victim records from across Europe.

archives.name: Arolsen Archives
archives.covers: The world's largest collection of documents on Nazi persecution: concentration camp records, forced labor, displaced persons, and tracing documents.

archives.name: USHMM Collections Search
archives.covers: United States Holocaust Memorial Museum collections: documents, photographs, oral histories, and survivor/victim records.

archives.name: EHRI Portal
archives.covers: European Holocaust Research Infrastructure — federates descriptions of Holocaust archival material held by hundreds of institutions across Europe.

archives.name: JewishGen
archives.covers: Major Jewish genealogy hub: the Holocaust Database, KehilaLinks town pages, the Family Finder, and the Communities Database for connecting people, towns, and living descendants.

archives.name: JewishGen Gazetteer & Communities Database
archives.covers: Identifies towns and shtetls in Central and Eastern Europe across changing spellings, languages, and national borders. Resolves which country a town belonged to in different periods.
best_for: finding the modern town and country

archives.name: FamilySearch
archives.covers: Free genealogy platform run by the LDS Church with vast vital, census, immigration, and naturalization records worldwide.

archives.name: Yizkor Books (NYPL Digital Collections)
archives.covers: Memorial books written by survivors commemorating destroyed Jewish communities — rich town-level history, names, and photographs.

archives.name: Auschwitz-Birkenau Memorial — Prisoner Database
archives.covers: Records and information on prisoners of the Auschwitz-Birkenau camp complex.

archives.name: Mémorial de la Shoah
archives.covers: France's principal Holocaust archive and memorial. Deportation records, Drancy detention records, and documentation of the Shoah in France.

archives.name: JRI-Poland (Jewish Records Indexing — Poland)
archives.covers: Index of Jewish vital records (births, marriages, deaths) from territories of present and former Poland.

archives.name: German Federal Archives (Bundesarchiv) — Gedenkbuch
archives.covers: German federal memorial book (Gedenkbuch) of Jewish victims from Germany, plus broader federal records.

archives.name: Joods Monument (Jewish Monument, Netherlands)
archives.covers: Commemorates Dutch Jews persecuted during the Holocaust, with biographical records and family links.

archives.name: CDEC — Fondazione Centro di Documentazione Ebraica Contemporanea
archives.covers: Italy's principal archive documenting the persecution and deportation of Italian Jews, including a database of victims.

archives.name: Ancestry / MyHeritage
archives.covers: Commercial genealogy platforms with immigration, census, naturalization, and ship manifest records. Useful but paywalled — prefer FamilySearch first.
